intro: Converting square feet (ft²) to acres (ac) is essential when translating measurements across real estate land deeds, agricultural plot surveying, flooring estimation, and architectural floor plans. One square foot equals 0.00002295 acres, while one acre equals 43,560 square feet. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many acres are in 1 square foot?
faqs.answer: There are 0.00002295 acres (ac) in 1 square foot (ft²). To convert ft² to ac, use the exact conversion factor 0.00002295.

faqs.question: How do I convert square feet to acres manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your square foot value by 0.00002295 (exact factor: 0.00002295). For example, 50 ft² × 0.00002295 = 0.00114784 ac.
